content.short: Littlecube Valley is an upcoming voxel sandbox-RPG, set in a medieval fantasy, persistent living world with NFTs.
content.description:
Our game project aims to create meaningful single-player experiences with stories that live on a persistent virtual world, while storing the historical events on the blockchain in the form of NFTs.

Our solution is an adaptation of a concept developed back in 2009 by Bart Stewart, known as The "Living World" Game. This concept explores the blending of single-player RPG experiences inside a persistent virtual world that is commonly found in massively multiplayer online RPGs.

Players get to explore a magical world that is full of life, procedurally generated, filled with civilisations and wilderness, adorable characters, perilous adventures and dangerous monsters. Our primary inspirations are, Cube World, Dwarf Fortress and Dragons Abound. Our proposal can be found on Project Catalyst Fund 8. https://cardano.ideascale.com/c/idea/399175
